newsitem.title: USA: W.W. GRAINGER ELECTS KEYSER CHAIRMAN.
newsitem.headline: W.W. GRAINGER ELECTS KEYSER CHAIRMAN.

text.p: W.W. Grainger Inc said Friday it elected Richard Keyser, 54, as chairman of the board, effective September 1.
He succeeds David Grainger, 69, who was elected senior chairman of the board. Keyser will continue as chief executive officer.
Keyser was elected president and chief executive officer in 1995 after serving as president and chief operating officer. He joined the company in 1992.
Grainger, who will remain a director, served as chief executive from 1968 to 1995.
The office of the chairman, the company's senior executive group, will continue to be composed of Keyser, Jere Fluno as vice chairman and Grainger.
Separately, Grainger said it elected Donald Bielinski, 48, and Wesley Clark, 45, as group presidents of the company, effective September 1.

Bielinski will be responsible for the company's emerging businesses, including Grainger Consulting Services, Grainger Integrated Supply Operations, Grainger SA de CV (Mexico) and Lab Safety Supply Inc. He is currently senior vice president, marketing and sales.
Clark will be responsible for the Grainger branch-based business, Acklands - Grainger Inc (Canada) and Parts Co of America. Clark is currently senior vice president, operations and quality.
